description: Implementation of NetworkInterfaceCache class for managing network interfaces on Fuchsia platform, including adding, updating, removing interfaces, and determining connection types.

classes.name: NetworkInterfaceCache
classes.description: Caches network interface information, manages interface lifecycle, and determines connection type.

methods.name: AddInterfaces
methods.description: Adds multiple network interfaces to the cache.

methods.name: AddInterface
methods.description: Adds a single network interface to the cache.

methods.name: ChangeInterface
methods.description: Updates an existing network interface in the cache.

methods.name: RemoveInterface
methods.description: Removes a network interface from the cache.

methods.name: GetOnlineInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves a list of online network interfaces.

methods.name: SetError
methods.description: Sets the cache to an error state, clearing data.

methods.name: UpdateConnectionTypeWhileLocked
methods.description: Updates the connection type based on current interfaces.

methods.name: SetErrorWhileLocked
methods.description: Internal method to set error state and clear data.
